items.title: Consent
clues: I must be informed and specific.
A person can take me back.
items.why: Consent is a person’s free, informed and specific agreement.

items.title: Contextual targeting
clues: I look at the page, not the person.
I match ads to the content around them.
I do not need a user ID.
An ad for running shoes on a marathon article is me.
items.why: Contextual targeting uses the page content instead of a person’s profile.

items.title: PII
clues: I can point to a real person.
A name or an email can be me.
Privacy rules are about protecting me.
items.why: PII is any information that can identify a person.
